faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to key questions about our digital invitation experience

items.q: How long does it take to create an invitation?
items.a: Invitations are typically completed in 1 to 3 business days. For urgent situations, we can deliver within a few hours. Signature custom projects follow an agreed timeline.
Absolutely. You can tailor colors, typography, add personal photos, choose your favorite music, and include custom timeline blocks.

items.q: Can I change the information later?
items.a: Yes, updates are fast and FREE! All updates apply immediately to your live link without having to resend anything to your guests.
Yes, you can choose any melody or soundtrack that plays when guests open your invitation, with an easy mute/unmute control.

items.q: What is RSVP and how do guests confirm attendance?
items.a: RSVP is an online attendance form. Guests enter their name, confirm whether they are attending, specify guest count, and note preferences. All responses appear in your live table.

items.q: Can guests open the invitation from any device?
items.a: Yes, every invitation is 100% responsive and optimized for iPhones, Android smartphones, tablets, and desktop computers.

items.q: Can I add Google Maps and Waze directions?
items.a: Yes, interactive map navigation buttons are integrated directly into the invitation for effortless one-tap routing.

items.q: How do I receive the final invitation?
items.a: You receive a beautiful dedicated link (e.g. elaris.am/your-event) that you can easily copy and share via WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, or SMS.

items.q: How long does the invitation link remain active?
items.a: Depending on your selected plan, links remain active from 6 months to 1 full year (or lifetime on our Signature package).
